title: Quietly Braised French Cherry Tomato Stew
description: A post-workout French dish featuring cherry tomatoes, slow-cooked in a ti-leaf wrap to create a bitter, glassy-jelly stew, friendly to ayurvedic-tamasic diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the cherry tomatoes with olive oil, onion, garlic, thyme, and bay leaves until the tomatoes are evenly coated.
Wrap the bowl with ti leaves, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Place the wrapped bowl in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot with a lid.
Pour the red wine into the pot, making sure the ti leaves are not submerged.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 hours, or until the cherry tomatoes have broken down and the liquid has thickened into a glassy jelly.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh thyme and a sprinkle of sea salt.
